test_strategy: Adopt a layered testing strategy combining unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, and security testing tailored for a Next.js + Node.js architecture integrated with PaymentCore (GraphQL) and Payment Rail REST APIs. Use Jest for unit tests, Supertest for API integration tests, Cypress for E2E UI validation, Locust for performance load simulation, and OWASP ZAP for security scanning. Ensure RBAC validation and audit logging are covered through both automated tests and manual validation within staging. CI/CD pipelines will execute test suites automatically inside the private VNet with parallel test runs.

test_cases.title: Verify merchant and payment batch search loads under 1.5s
test_cases.description: Ensure OpsAnalyst can search merchants and payment batches and receive results from both PaymentCore and Payment Rail APIs within SLA.
steps: Enter merchant ID and date range
test_cases.expected_result: Search results appear within 1.5s showing merchant and batch info merged from both APIs.

test_cases.title: Validate settlement timeline renders correctly per rail type
test_cases.description: Confirm batch timelines aggregate ACH, RTP, and wire events correctly from Payment Rail APIs.
preconditions: Payment Rail APIs return timeline data
test_cases.expected_result: Settlement events appear grouped by rail type with correct timestamps and statuses.

test_cases.title: Trigger refund emits audit logs to Kafka and S3
test_cases.description: Verify refund initiation posts to Payment Actions service and creates audit entries.
steps: Verify audit log in Kafka topic and S3 archive
test_cases.expected_result: Refund action succeeds and audit data is stored in both Kafka and S3.

test_cases.title: Approve payout only accessible for Manager role
test_cases.description: Validate RBAC gating prevents unauthorized users from approving payouts.
preconditions: Users with OpsAnalyst, Manager, and Auditor roles available
test_cases.expected_result: Only Manager receives 200 Approved response; other roles receive 403 Access Denied.

test_cases.title: Audit-ready report generates and downloads successfully
test_cases.description: Ensure Auditor can export audit logs from S3 archive in chosen format.
steps: Verify file contents include expected actions and timestamps
test_cases.expected_result: System generates downloadable CSV/XLSX report containing valid audit logs.

test_cases.title: Display anomaly alerts for payment batches
test_cases.description: Verify real-time alerts appear for anomalies detected in Payment Rail streams.
preconditions: A batch with known anomalies exists
steps: Verify alert list shows type and severity
test_cases.expected_result: Alerts for delays or mismatches appear with proper severity and investigation link.

test_cases.title: Negative test - Unauthorized refund attempt blocked
test_cases.description: Ensure refund trigger cannot be executed by non-OpsAnalyst roles.
preconditions: User logged in as Manager or Auditor
test_cases.expected_result: System returns 403 authorization error, no audit log generated.

test_cases.title: Performance - Payout initiation round-trip <4s
test_cases.description: Measure time taken for payout approval and disbursement confirmation.
test_cases.expected_result: Full round-trip completes under 4s with audit entry generated.

test_cases.title: Audit log retry mechanism functions on delivery failure
test_cases.description: Simulate Kafka downtime and ensure auditEmitter retries or logs errors properly.
steps: Verify retry attempt or error handling behavior
test_cases.expected_result: AuditEmitter either performs retry or logs failure without data loss.

test_cases.title: End-to-end RBAC access matrix validation
test_cases.description: Verify all protected endpoints enforce proper role-based access.
preconditions: All user types provisioned with tokens
steps: Iterate over API endpoints with different tokens
test_cases.expected_result: Access pattern matches RBAC matrix: OpsAnalyst(search/refund), Manager(approval), Auditor(report).

test_data_requirements: Sample merchants with varying regions and statuses
Payment batches across ACH, RTP, and wire rails
Test payment IDs for refund initiation
Pending payout IDs requiring Manager approval
Audit log samples for export validation
Synthetic anomaly event payloads (delayed, mismatched amounts)
User tokens/credentials representing OpsAnalyst, Manager, Auditor
automation_approach: Use Jest for backend unit tests (controllers, middleware, auditEmitter). Employ Supertest for Express API integration. Cypress E2E tests will automate UI flows—search, refund, approval, report export—executing via headless CI runners. Performance tests using Locust target /api/payouts/approve and /api/merchants/search endpoints. Security tests will run OWASP ZAP scans and automated RBAC role validation scripts in CI pipeline. All test data seeded via mock GraphQL and REST API simulators inside VNet. GitHub Actions or internal runner triggers will run nightly regression suites.
coverage_goals: Achieve >=90% unit test coverage for all controllers and utilities, 100% role access validation, 95% API integration coverage (positive + negative paths), E2E verification for 100% user stories, performance compliance for critical operations (<1.5s search, <4s payouts), and audit emission validation in 100% of relevant actions.
